title: Add account
description: Choose how to sign in or what to import.
methods.builderid.title: AWS Builder ID
methods.builderid.description: Add a personal account with AWS Builder ID.
methods.iam.title: IAM Identity Center (Enterprise SSO)
methods.iam.description: Add an enterprise account with IAM Identity Center SSO.
methods.microsoft.title: Microsoft SSO
methods.microsoft.description: Add an account with a Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) sign-in.
methods.sso.title: SSO token
methods.sso.description: Add accounts with the x-amz-sso_authn token from your browser.
methods.local.title: Kiro local cache
methods.local.description: Add an account with the Kiro IDE local cache files.
methods.credentials.title: Credentials JSON
methods.credentials.description: Add accounts with credentials exported from Kiro Account Manager.
methods.cookie.title: Kiro web cookie
methods.cookie.description: Add an account with the refresh token from your Kiro web cookie.
methods.apikey.title: Kiro API key
methods.apikey.description: Add a headless account with a Kiro CLI API key (ksk_…).
builderid.verifyCode: Enter this code at the link below.
iam.completeLogin: Complete sign-in in your browser, then paste the callback URL.
microsoft.portalStep: Step 1: sign in to the Kiro portal
microsoft.callbackInstructions: Open the link and sign in. Your browser then shows a page that fails to load at http://localhost:3128. That is expected. Copy the full address from the address bar and paste it below.
microsoft.selectProfileDesc: This account has more than one Kiro profile. Choose the one this proxy should use.
sso.step2: Press F12 to open DevTools → Application → Cookies.
sso.tokenHint: One token per line. Pasting several imports them in a batch. Each token can take up to 2 minutes to import.
sso.tokenRequired: Paste at least one SSO token.
local.clientHint: Needed for IdC sign-in. Paste the file contents or upload the file.
local.clientHintMicrosoft: Needed only when kiro-auth-token.json has no clientId. Paste the file contents or upload the file.
local.pasteOrUpload: Paste the file contents or upload the file.
local.clientMissingNamed: IdC sign-in needs {file}.json, named after clientIdHash in kiro-auth-token.json.
local.microsoftChoiceHint: For a Microsoft sign-in, choose Microsoft (Entra ID) as the provider.
local.microsoftClientIdMissing: Microsoft sign-in needs the Entra application (client) ID as a UUID. Add clientId to kiro-auth-token.json, or paste the {hash}.json that contains it.
local.microsoftTenantMissing: Microsoft sign-in needs the tenant. kiro-auth-token.json must contain tokenEndpoint, issuerUrl or an Entra accessToken.
credentials.label: Credentials JSON
credentials.formats: Accepts one object, a JSON array or a Kiro Account Manager export.
credentials.required: Required: refreshToken, or kiroApiKey for API key accounts.
credentials.optional: Optional: provider (BuilderId, Enterprise, GitHub, Google), clientId, clientSecret, region.
credentials.parseError: The text is not valid JSON.
cookie.howToGet: How to get the refresh token
cookie.step2: Right-click the page → Inspect → Application → Cookies →
cookie.step3: Copy the value of the cookie named
apikey.help: Kiro API keys never expire and skip OAuth refresh. Requests go to the Kiro CLI runtime in the key's region.
apikey.keysHint: One per line. Add a region with ksk_…|eu-central-1.
apikey.regionHint: Used for keys without a |region suffix.
apikey.keyMissing: Enter at least one Kiro API key.
